clue.text: See 18 Across

explanation.walkthrough: 'in which' is a link; 'Christian body' must be read as one phrase meaning the worldwide church.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the white christening garment put on an infant at baptism, a sacred robe.

clue.text: Some restraint for Greek in high dudgeon

indicators.note: a restraint holds something in, so the first word wraps around the Greek abbreviation

parts.note: some means any, as in 'have you any?'

explanation.surface: A Greek showing some self-control while being furious.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in high dudgeon is to be indignant and resentful, which is the same as being furious.

parts.note: Rio Ferdinand is an England footballer

explanation.walkthrough: Rio Ferdinand is a former England and Manchester United defender; 'in' is a link word.

clue.text: Taught beginners of three and upwards to read, withholding top mark

explanation.walkthrough: 'and' is a link between the two words whose first letters are picked; 'withholding' removes A from TO READ to leave TORED.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who was coached or instructed privately was taught.

clue.text: High explosive found among newly martyred K fighters

indicators.note: the explosive is found among the other letters, so it sits inside them
newly signals the letters of the word are made anew in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Explosives discovered with fighters who have recently died for their cause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'newly' rearranges the eight letters to TREDARMY; the stray K before 'fighters' is a printing slip and plays no part.
explanation.definitionFit: The Soviet Union's armed forces were soldiers, so a body of fighters.

clue.text: See 24

clue.text: Song-filled act going N N on later?

clue.text: Crime novelist speaks about medical drama

clue.text: Lethal weapon generating a dry heat

indicators.note: the letters are used to generate, or produce, a new word in another order

explanation.surface: A deadly weapon that produces a scorching, arid heat.

clue.text: Soldier gets it sometime after midnight in Italian city

taken as written

clue.text: Disease blights classy old flame

clue.text: Geraint's girl provided with hidden identity

explanation.surface: A knight's sweetheart is given a secret persona.
explanation.walkthrough: In Tennyson's Idylls of the King, Geraint is the knight whose wife has this name.
explanation.definitionFit: In Arthurian legend the wife of the knight Geraint is a celebrated heroine.

clue.text: Bit too fresh in the strait

parts.note: the Solent is the strait between the Isle of Wight and mainland England

explanation.surface: Something a little too brisk and cold out on the water channel.
explanation.walkthrough: The Solent is the strait separating the Isle of Wight from Hampshire on England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Being fresh can mean cheeky, so a little too cheeky is rude and disrespectful.

clue.text: Formal tone of Brown's senior ministers

explanation.definitionFit: The nickname for an inner committee of senior Cabinet ministers deciding spending, borrowed from the secretive Tudor court.

clue.text: Box Independent delivered

clue.text: Plant a couple in the garden

definitions.meaning: a name given to cuckoopint and certain orchids
the first man and woman, who lived in Eden

explanation.definitionFit: The biblical first pair in Eden also gives its name to wild arum, a woodland flower.

clue.text: Wife dreads knitting Christian jumper

explanation.walkthrough: Jonathan Edwards, the British triple jump champion, was known for his Christian faith; 'jumper' plays on the knitted garment.

clue.text: Old alumnus set up wine outlet

clue.text: Course of true love running anything but smooth!

explanation.walkthrough: Mark Knopfler was the guitarist of Dire Straits; the band name is split, its first word signalling the rearrangement.
